text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management. First, plan your tasks and set a clear schedule so you know how much time each step will take. Next, prioritization is important: focus on the most urgent and important work before smaller tasks. Scope management also matters, because trying to do too much can make you miss a deadline. Be realistic about what you can finish and reduce the work if necessary. Finally, communication is key. If you see a problem, tell your team or manager early instead of waiting until the last minute. By combining these skills, you can reduce stress and meet your deadlines more successfully.
